## About

I'm a final-year Informatics student building toward a SOC Analyst role, with a longer-term focus on malware analysis and threat intelligence. Each write-up here tries to go beyond "what got me the flag" — I also break down what a defensive team would have caught, and where.

## Disclaimer

All rooms documented here were solved in authorized lab environments. Sensitive values such as credentials, private key contents, and flags are redacted from screenshots and write-ups.
